subject: Post-call recap: Redwood integration & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: Redwood integration & next steps

Hi Samantha — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our call and next steps so we’re all aligned.

Key problems you called out:
- Inconsistent latency on your current embed+search pipeline during peak traffic (up to 2x P95).
- High per-query cost due to overprovisioned GPU endpoints and lack of batching/caching.
- Need for structured outputs to reliably extract product attributes for your catalog enrichment pipeline.

Goals we discussed:
- Reduce P95 latency to < 300ms for single-turn queries.
- Cut per-embedding query cost by ~30% through batching, quantization recommendations, and prefix caching.
- Provide a deterministic structured output path for downstream ETL (JSON schema and field-level confidence scores).

Product fit + integration notes (high level):
- SDK changes: your engineers can use our JS/py SDK; the streaming APIs will let you start serving partial responses while we warm KV cache.
- Function calling: we can surface structured outputs via function-like calls (returns parseable JSON for attributes).
- Embeddings & reranking: we recommend using our hybrid approach — server-side embedding generation + reranker for top-K scoring to reduce tokens sent to the model.

Proposed immediate next steps:
1) Tech sync w/ your engineering team (30–45m) — propose Wed 6/23 or Thu 6/24.
2) Share integration checklist and a sample implementation for streaming/function-calling. (I attached the checklist and a short proposal.)
3) 2-week POC: dedicated small pool, baseline metrics, and quality checks on structured outputs.

Attachments: redwood-integration-proposal.pdf, api-integration-checklist.xlsx

If that looks right, I’ll send a calendar invite for the tech sync and loop in Solutions Engineering.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Senior AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Redwood Inference — Production-grade LLM inference for product teams
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Redwood integration & next steps

Thanks Marissa — this is great and matches my notes. A few clarifications from our side: 

- Latency: 300ms P95 is a good target — we care most about search latency for our customer-facing product page. The internal analytics batch can be higher latency.
- Structured outputs: we need a fixed schema with field-level confidence; if confidence < threshold, we want to route to human review.
- Reranking: important — we need the reranker to run client-side after candidate generation, or server-side if it reduces total token cost. Can you confirm which approach would be lower cost in practice?

Availability for tech sync: Wed 6/23 at 10:00am PT works for our eng lead (Samir) and myself. Please include any pre-read so we can share internally.

Also, one procurement note — Acme requires a standard security questionnaire (we’ll send it tomorrow). We’ll also need an estimated committed cost for a 2-week POC (ballpark is fine).

Appreciate it — Samantha
Samantha Lee | Head of Search & Recommendations, Acme Corp
samantha.lee@acme.com | +1 617-555-9912
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: Redwood integration & next steps

Perfect — thanks for confirming. Quick answers to your questions and what we’ll cover in the tech sync: 

- Reranking cost: server-side reranking (we run the reranker as a lightweight model in the same request flow) generally reduces total token/io cost because candidates are scored without sending full contexts back-and-forth. We’ll include a cost comparison in the pre-read.
- Structured outputs: we’ll demo function-calling that returns a JSON schema + confidence per field. You can set a confidence threshold to trigger human review.
- SDK & streaming: the SDK will provide streaming partial tokens while the model generates; the client can assemble or consume partial structured outputs as they arrive. For your POC we recommend our Python SDK + streaming enabled.

Pre-read & attachments: I attached the API integration checklist and a short proposal with recommended model/quantization settings and estimated POC costs. 

Tech sync invite: I’m scheduling Wed 6/23 10:00am PT and sent a calendar invite (invite from marissa.cole@redwood.ai). Call agenda will be:
- 10m intro & goals
- 20m architecture & integration path (SDK, streaming, function calling) — Dev will walk through sample code
- 10m metrics & POC success criteria

Action items before the call:
- Acme: send security questionnaire (Samantha)
- Redwood: send pre-read + example code (Marissa) — attached

Looking forward to the sync.

Best,
Marissa
